carrot.definition: An edible root vegetable, often orange but also other colours.
carrot.exampleUsage: Hala adds a carrot to the soup.

potato.definition: An edible starchy tuber of the potato plant.
potato.exampleUsage: The potato is in the vegetable basket.

sweet-potato.definition: A sweet-tasting root vegetable with orange, white, or purple flesh.
sweet-potato.exampleUsage: The sweet potato has orange flesh.

beet.definition: An edible root vegetable, often red but also golden or other colours.
beet.exampleUsage: The cut beet has red flesh.

turnip.definition: A round root vegetable with white or purple skin and pale flesh.
turnip.exampleUsage: Hala buys a turnip for soup.

radish.definition: A small, crisp root vegetable with a sharp taste, often eaten raw.
radish.exampleUsage: A radish is in the salad bowl.

parsnip.definition: A pale root vegetable shaped like a carrot, with a sweet taste.
parsnip.exampleUsage: The parsnip has a pale tapered root.

ginger.definition: An aromatic underground stem called a rhizome, used in food.
ginger.exampleUsage: She grated fresh ginger into the soup.

yam.definition: A starchy edible tuber with rough skin, often cooked like a potato.
yam.exampleUsage: The seller names the tuber as a yam.

rutabaga.definition: A large round root vegetable with purple skin and yellow flesh.
rutabaga.exampleUsage: The rutabaga is beside the turnip.

lettuce.definition: A leafy green vegetable often used in salads.
lettuce.exampleUsage: The lettuce is ready for the salad.

spinach.definition: A leafy green vegetable eaten raw or cooked.
spinach.exampleUsage: Hala buys a bunch of spinach.

kale.definition: A leafy cabbage-family vegetable with curled or flat leaves.
kale.exampleUsage: The curly kale is in the greens crate.

arugula.definition: A leafy salad vegetable with a slightly peppery taste.
arugula.exampleUsage: Arugula is in the salad mix.

cabbage.definition: A leafy vegetable with a tightly packed, round head.
cabbage.exampleUsage: The cabbage has tightly packed leaves.

chard.definition: A leafy green vegetable with broad leaves and thick edible stems.

collard-greens.definition: Large dark-green leafy vegetables from the cabbage family.
collard-greens.exampleUsage: Omar buys collard greens for dinner.

romaine.definition: A type of lettuce with long, crisp leaves.
romaine.exampleUsage: The romaine has long crisp leaves.

watercress.definition: A leafy green vegetable that grows in water and has a peppery taste.
watercress.exampleUsage: The seller identifies the greens as watercress.

bok-choy.definition: A type of Chinese cabbage with thick pale stalks and dark-green leaves.
bok-choy.exampleUsage: The bok choy has pale stalks and green leaves.

broccoli.definition: A green vegetable with a thick stem and clusters of small flower buds.

cauliflower.definition: A vegetable with a compact head of immature flowers, often white.
cauliflower.exampleUsage: The cauliflower head is on the stall.

brussels-sprouts.definition: Small green vegetables from the cabbage family that grow as tight leaf buds on a stalk.
brussels-sprouts.exampleUsage: Brussels sprouts are in a small basket.

kohlrabi.definition: A vegetable with a round, swollen stem and crisp flesh.
kohlrabi.exampleUsage: The kohlrabi has a swollen stem.

rapini.definition: A leafy green vegetable with small broccoli-like buds, also called broccoli rabe.
rapini.exampleUsage: The rapini has leafy stems and small buds.

napa-cabbage.definition: A pale-green Chinese cabbage with a long oval head and crinkled leaves.
napa-cabbage.exampleUsage: The napa cabbage has a long head.

red-cabbage.definition: A cabbage variety with tightly packed reddish-purple leaves.
red-cabbage.exampleUsage: The red cabbage has purple-red leaves.

savoy-cabbage.definition: A cabbage variety with crinkled green leaves and a loose round head.
savoy-cabbage.exampleUsage: The savoy cabbage has crinkled leaves.

romanesco.definition: A green vegetable related to cauliflower and broccoli, known for its pointed spiral-shaped florets.
romanesco.exampleUsage: The romanesco has pointed spiral florets.

broccolini.definition: A green vegetable with long tender stems, small florets, and leaves, related to broccoli.
broccolini.exampleUsage: The broccolini has long slender stems.

zucchini.definition: A summer squash with tender skin, often green or yellow.

pumpkin.definition: A squash fruit used as a vegetable, with varied size and colour.
pumpkin.exampleUsage: The pumpkin is beside the squash.

butternut-squash.definition: A winter squash with tan skin, orange flesh, and a bulb-shaped lower end.
butternut-squash.exampleUsage: The butternut squash has a bulb-shaped lower end.

acorn-squash.definition: A small ribbed winter squash with dark-green skin and yellow-orange flesh.
acorn-squash.exampleUsage: The acorn squash has deep ribs.

spaghetti-squash.definition: A winter squash whose cooked flesh separates into long strands resembling spaghetti.
spaghetti-squash.exampleUsage: The cooked spaghetti squash separates into strands.

cucumber.definition: A long green vegetable with crisp, watery flesh, often eaten raw.
cucumber.exampleUsage: A cucumber is ready for the salad.

gourd.definition: A fruit of a gourd-family plant, grown for food or decoration depending on type.
gourd.exampleUsage: The ornamental gourd is kept for decoration.

chayote.definition: A pale-green pear-shaped squash with crisp mild flesh.
chayote.exampleUsage: The chayote is pale green and pear-shaped.

bitter-melon.definition: A tropical gourd with a bumpy green surface and a characteristically bitter taste.
bitter-melon.exampleUsage: The bitter melon has a bumpy surface.

delicata.definition: A small winter squash with cream-colored skin marked by green or orange stripes.
delicata.exampleUsage: The delicata squash has striped skin.

tomato.definition: A soft red fruit used in salads, sauces, and cooking.
tomato.exampleUsage: The tomato is beside the cucumber.

bell-pepper.definition: A mild, hollow pepper that may be green, red, yellow, or orange.
bell-pepper.exampleUsage: Sara buys a bell pepper for the meal.

chili-pepper.definition: A small pepper with a hot taste, used to add heat to food.
chili-pepper.exampleUsage: The seller names the pepper as a chili pepper.

eggplant.definition: A vegetable with smooth, usually purple skin and soft flesh when cooked.
eggplant.exampleUsage: The eggplant is on the stall.

jalape-o.definition: A medium-hot green or red chili pepper commonly used in cooking.
jalape-o.exampleUsage: The recipe lists jalapeño as an ingredient.

habanero.definition: A small very hot chili pepper, often orange, red, or yellow when ripe.
habanero.exampleUsage: The seller identifies the pepper as habanero.

serrano.definition: A small, hot chili pepper that is green or red.
serrano.exampleUsage: The serrano peppers are in a separate basket.

poblano.definition: A mild to moderately hot dark-green chili pepper from Mexico.
poblano.exampleUsage: The poblano is beside the serrano.

cayenne.definition: A long and often twisted hot red pepper.
cayenne.exampleUsage: The jar contains ground cayenne pepper.

paprika.definition: A red spice made from dried and ground peppers.
paprika.exampleUsage: Paprika is in the spice jar.

onion.definition: A strong-smelling vegetable with layers used in cooking.
onion.exampleUsage: The cook adds onion to the soup.

garlic.definition: A strongly flavored bulb made of cloves, used to season food.
garlic.exampleUsage: A garlic bulb contains several cloves.

leek.definition: A vegetable with a long white stem and flat green leaves, related to onions.
leek.exampleUsage: The leek has flat green leaves.

shallot.definition: A small onion-like vegetable with a mild flavor, used in cooking.
shallot.exampleUsage: The shallot is beside the onion.

scallion.definition: A young onion with a long green stem and a small white base.
scallion.exampleUsage: The scallion has a white base and green top.

chive.definition: A thin green herb with a mild onion flavor, often cut into small pieces.
chive.exampleUsage: The cook adds one chive as a garnish.

asparagus.definition: A green vegetable eaten as young, tender stalks.
asparagus.exampleUsage: The asparagus spears are in a bundle.

celery.definition: A crisp vegetable with long pale-green stalks and leaves.

artichoke.definition: An edible immature flower head with fleshy bases to its bracts and a heart.
artichoke.exampleUsage: The artichoke is in the vegetable basket.

fennel.definition: A vegetable with a pale bulb and feathery leaves, with a mild anise flavor.
fennel.exampleUsage: The fennel has a pale bulb and feathery leaves.
